body: CORRECTION after checking the current source contract: my final sentence was too compressed. SurfaceDetail is deliberately only the Hidden, Sentences, Tokens zoom axis, and SurfaceDetailSupport is only the capability proof for those layers. BoundaryEvidence and BoundaryBelief must not be routed through or added to that enum. What the spike should reuse is the landed exact surface-coordinate discipline and renderer contract: stable exact gaps and spans on the discourse axis, no invented projection-y meaning, typed refusal when required source detail is absent. The perceptual boundary track itself needs a separate compiled mark and identity only after the grain and instruction ADR settles its provider vocabulary. Until then, a StoryAtlas prototype can lower the existing bare-Int records privately for the frozen decision fixture, but it must not publish that accidental Int shape or ask SurfaceDetail to carry scientific boundary semantics. The rest of the prior post stands: receipt-directed cross-highlighting, separate identities at co-located gaps, missing distinct from zero, retained rejected beliefs, and no probability formatting without calibration.
